technical_complexity.rationale: Generating structured whiteboard style video in near real time means orchestrating an LLM, layout, drawing and speech, which a two person team can build in three months. The hard part is quality and speed at low cost, and dependence on third party models.

takeover_risk.rationale: Platforms already ship video overviews, and a funded YC peer exists in the same niche. A well resourced rival could add whiteboard style output within a few months, so risk is high.

narrative.headline: A fast moving AI video wedge with a funded YC rival and heavy platform risk.
narrative.general_summary: Lamina Labs is a two person Spring 2026 company building near real time structured video generation, starting with a whiteboard style explainer product called Simi. Interest in generative video is high and the closest YC analog raised a 4.1 million seed within two months of launch. The risks are that model labs ship the feature, that a funded competitor already holds the niche, and that explainer videos are an occasional need with weak retention. The most likely outcome is a seed round if launch metrics are strong, followed by a difficult Series A.
